negatives.operation: combined mandatory skill and discovery read
negatives.failure_signature: The combined command exceeded its bounded execution window before returning a complete receipt.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Multiple mandatory full-file reads and repository discovery shared one orchestration envelope.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and split each mandatory skill and reference read into a complete standalone command.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Read each mandatory instruction file completely in its own bounded operation before repository work; never infer completion from a timed-out batch.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; only the later complete standalone reads are witnesses

negatives.failure_signature: The exact v644-v6 and Method Flow keyword query returned no matches and exit code 1 despite newer context existing in the task-group index and ad-hoc note.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The query assumed the newest context repeated exact phase terms in the top-level registry.
negatives.recovery: Inspected the current exact-head task group and newest same-day ad-hoc note, while preserving the no-match result.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat an exact-keyword no-match as a search result, not absence of memory; inspect the newest indexed task group and same-day note before stopping.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; memory context was accepted only from the later direct reads

negatives.operation: parallel source and owner equality audit
negatives.failure_signature: The first three-lane parallel verification exceeded the runner window before yielding usable combined output.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Two network fetches, large-worktree status scans, ancestry checks, and a named-lane scan shared one parent envelope.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and ran fetch, local ancestry, live-remote equality, and named-lane cleanliness as separate witnesses.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate network and large-status operations; allow the observed D-drive scan time and preserve each exact witness independently.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; only later exact local, upstream, tracking, live, ancestry, and cleanliness receipts are evidence

negatives.failure_signature: A valid ripgrep no-match exit code stopped the orchestrated sequence before later novelty patterns ran.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The batch treated exit code 1 as an operational fault rather than the documented no-match state.
negatives.recovery: Retained the interrupted probe and reran one explicit no-match-tolerant title audit over the 29 proposal files.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Normalize ripgrep exit 1 to an explicit NO_MATCH witness when absence is the intended semantic result; reserve other nonzero codes for faults.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; semantic novelty relies on the later complete 290-proposal audit

negatives.failure_signature: The read-only optional-feature command reported that elevation was required.
negatives.trigger_precondition: DISM-backed feature status inspection requires an elevated token on this host even when no change is requested.
negatives.recovery: Stopped without elevation, feature change, security weakening, or reboot; used non-elevating executable and command-presence checks, which found Sandbox unavailable.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Audit executable and command presence first; if feature status requires elevation, record unavailable and do not retry with privilege.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; Sandbox remains unavailable and no sandbox execution is claimed

negatives.failure_signature: PowerShell rejected the replacement dictionary at parse time because case-insensitive keys treated V6446 and v6446 as duplicates.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A case-insensitive hash literal was used for case-sensitive source-token replacements.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parse failure, confirmed no destination file was created, and changed the rewrite map to an ordered array of explicit case-sensitive pairs.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use ordered pair arrays with String.Replace when replacement keys differ only by case; verify destination absence or exact diff after any parse failure.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected command made no repository change

negatives.failure_signature: Git's default porcelain view collapsed the untracked phase directory, making 42 existing expected files appear missing in the comparison.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The exact-file audit parsed default git status output without requesting all untracked files.
negatives.recovery: Retained the false-negative receipt and reran with git status --porcelain -uall plus direct expected-path existence checks.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use -uall or compare the Git index after staging when an exact file set contains a new directory tree; never treat a collapsed directory entry as its children.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the collapsed view is not exact staged-file evidence

retention_rule: Recovery does not erase failure evidence; only successful corrected runs may be promoted.
